elements.label: Secondary Objective: Raid the Command Post
elements.description: In that accursed building in the distance, the German command post is transmitting dense radio signals.
This is no ordinary assault. This is about using steel and blood to extract the fanged tooth embedded in our defensive line.
'Either plant the red flag on that building, or remain forever on this artillery-scorched earth.'

elements.label: Edge-Long Struggle
elements.description: War demands sacrifice, and it demands your Edge-Long struggle. You will meet your fated enemy. Remember, she is a follower of the Colonel—yet she is also mortal. You must overcome your enemy to be acknowledged by the great power of Struggle. The fire of struggle must burn hot. When all is prepared, the final moment will come. You and your fated enemy must reach that end—the point where you have no retreat. This ritual will ultimately conclude in death, and this may drive you to struggle against each other until the end of days.

elements.label: The Struggle
elements.description: Testament to the Struggle Between You and Your Arch Enemy.

elements.label: Strife Summons
elements.description: It seems the Germans have taken notice of our offensive. They're rallying their troops. [While this card is in play, it counts as one point of 'Strife.' Von Helling will appear in the next city garrisoned by an officer. This card is then discarded.]

elements.label: The arch enemy's Defeat
elements.description: My arch nemesis and I both learned from the Colonel's teachings—to draw strength from our scars. This bitter defeat may yet allow her to harness even greater power... but for now, she needs time to lick her wounds. [Von Helling will not appear in the next three regions.]

elements.label: Challenger's Mark [arch enemy]
elements.description: This marks what your arch enemy has become. Now war follows her, ceaselessly. [When Von Helling is in play, this card counts as three points of 'Strife.' No Blade Edge-Long will come to attack you.]

elements.label: The Iron Eater Bleeds!
elements.description: The wound my arch enemy inflicted upon that immortal will remind the Wolf-Splitter's Edge-Long that even he can die. [When Von Helling is in play, this card counts as one point of 'Strife.']

elements.label: The Iron Eater's Crushing Defeat
elements.description: This decisive loss will long remind this Edge-Long that he will die—slowly, absolutely, miserably. His ignominious retreat stands as proof. [When Von Helling is in play, this card counts as one point of 'Strife.']

elements.label: The arch enemy Vanquished
elements.description: Your arch enemy's spirit has returned to the void. No German remains your equal in battle. In this strand of history, her story has reached its end. [When in play, this card counts as two points of 'Strife.' This will negate the next five fear penalties.]
